Push (N1) and name (N3) routes are closed under the stated Landlock/netns/propagation/file-handle premises. The W-owned namespace choice is justified by P-UCOUNT. The identity-map set-ID-root privilege risk is contained only under P-NOSUID and P-NOCAP, which are correctly flagged critical with redesign-on-failure. One vector is under-surfaced: A1 may invoke the sicarii->wlscratch sudo rule to obtain euid W, which holds the owner rule and CAP_SYS_PTRACE over every U8; the pull closure for A1 therefore rests on reviewed writer.py (adversarial argv) never entering a U8, named only in §16/§2.2/P-SETNS and not in N2's A1 analysis (RC W1-V8-WRITER-AS-W). The SIV is correct and complete only as a premise-conditional argument; it launders nothing and establishes no custody. Every premise is NAMED_UNESTABLISHED.

SIV supersedes v7 (a); c8 root-owned rejected on host-wide accounting; SIV+PIDns rejected because a delegated user-manager scope breaks v5's terminal predicate; SIV-without-netns rejected on inbound abstract sockets; broker and forwarder correctly listed as V1/V2 rework candidates, not adopted, with full costs; BPF-LSM recorded unavailable on this boot (read fact).
